# t40: gate commands see the task's context via MTT_TASK_* env (no {{}} change)
exec mtt init
cp envcfg.yaml .mtt/config.yaml
exec mtt add 'Ship auth' --type epic
stdout 'created e1'
exec mtt add 'sub' --parent e1
stdout 'created t1'

# tbd -> in_progress gate echoes $MTT_TASK_TITLE (proves the title env reached the
# gate); output is captured with --log-file, then grepped.
exec mtt status e1 in_progress --log-file e1.log
stdout 'e1: tbd → in_progress'
grep 'TITLE=\[Ship auth\]' e1.log

# in_progress -> done gate is a roll-up over $MTT_TASK_CHILDREN_JSON (POSIX sh, no
# jq): while any child is still tbd the move is BLOCKED. Child t1 is tbd here.
! exec mtt status e1 done
stderr 'blocked'
exec mtt show e1
stdout '\[in_progress\]'

# drive the child to done (task flow, no gates), then the parent's roll-up passes.
exec mtt status t1 in_progress
exec mtt status t1 done
exec mtt status e1 done
stdout 'e1: in_progress → done'

-- envcfg.yaml --
version: 1
project:
  name: demo
command_timeout: 5m
types:
  - name: epic
    prefix: e
    parents: []
    statuses:
      - {name: tbd, kind: initial}
      - {name: in_progress, kind: active}
      - {name: done, kind: terminal}
      - {name: cancelled, kind: terminal}
    transitions:
      - {from: tbd, to: in_progress, commands: ['echo "TITLE=[$MTT_TASK_TITLE]"']}
      - {from: tbd, to: cancelled}
      - {from: in_progress, to: done, commands: ['case "$MTT_TASK_CHILDREN_JSON" in *tbd*) echo "a child is not done" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac']}
      - {from: in_progress, to: cancelled}
  - name: task
    prefix: t
    default: true
    parents: [epic]
    statuses:
      - {name: tbd, kind: initial}
      - {name: in_progress, kind: active}
      - {name: done, kind: terminal}
      - {name: cancelled, kind: terminal}
    transitions:
      - {from: tbd, to: in_progress}
      - {from: tbd, to: cancelled}
      - {from: in_progress, to: done}
      - {from: in_progress, to: cancelled}
